reason: I do not want to quote blind against my competitors on price, and I cannot see what the other verified partners will charge before I send mine. Handing over my ID and registration and waiting for a reviewer just to start is one more thing I have to chase in a week that is already full.
objection: If I quote without knowing what the others charge, I either lose the job or work for too little, and I have no way to check that from inside the app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real jobs from businesses like mine in Riyadh or Cairo, with the price visible and the money actually paid out to a seller on time.
